question: At the live pins, does the f0_binding.consistency_evidence declared by the three vacuum class schemas actually establish the F0-to-schema consistency it is relied upon for - specifically, does its check domain cover the visibility strength direction on which F0 and F1 rev13 disagree?
method: Read-only, hash-pinned. (1) Measure every declared pin at entry and exit. (2) Extract the three f0_binding blocks verbatim. (3) Reproduce the declared evidence byte-for-byte by running the EXACT canonical checker bytes inside a sandbox ROOT with copies of its declared inputs, so no canonical path is written. (4) Census the checker's compared-field domain from its source and from a set of sandbox mutation controls: (M1a) inject the probe token J-(I+) into the AF-WCC-VAC-GEN conclusion text, (M1b) flip the live variants[0].definition 'Strictly stronger' to 'Strictly weaker', (M1c) flip the live conclusion-prose 'is strictly stronger' to 'is strictly weaker', (M2) mutate an in-domain lead-contract regularity_token, (M3) flip the F1 schema SET relation WEAKER to STRONGER. (5) Census live F0 statements that assert the superseded direction and live F1 statements that assert the corrected direction. (6) Census review reliance on the declared evidence hash.
hypotheses: H1: all three class schemas declare f0_binding.consistency_evidence = artifacts/formulation/evidence/taxonomy_consistency.json#9e335e9b at the live pins, and the declared hash resolves.
H2: the declared evidence reproduces byte-for-byte from the canonical checker bytes at the live pins (the hash-level chain is intact).

H3: the canonical checker opens no schemas/* file and compares no variants block; its only direction-sensitive probe is the lexical test for 'J-(I+)' or 'J^-(I+)' in the AF-WCC-VAC-GEN conclusion text.

H4: live F0 asserts the SET relation as strictly stronger in at least two places (variants[0].definition; classes.AF-WCC-VAC-GEN.conclusion.text) while live F1 rev13 asserts strictly weaker; the H3 probe fires on neither.
H5: sandbox mutations M1b and M1c leave the checker CONSISTENT, M1a and M2 make it INCONSISTENT, and M3 leaves its output unchanged.

pre_registered_verdicts.SCOPE_GAP_CONFIRMED: H1-H5 all hold: the declared evidence resolves and reproduces, but its domain cannot see the live F0/F1 direction contradiction; the binding is hash-valid and semantically non-covering on that axis.
pre_registered_verdicts.SCOPE_GAP_REFUTED: some pinned checker/evidence in the acceptance pipeline covers the direction relation, or the live F0/F1 statements agree, or a mutation control behaves contrary to H5.

falsifier: A pinned artifact in the formulation acceptance pipeline whose compared-field set covers the visibility strength relation between F0's SET variant text and the class schemas' SET relation; or a live F0 revision whose direction statements agree with F1 rev13; or a sandbox control that the canonical checker handles contrary to H5 (which would falsify the harness rather than the finding).
non_claims: not a gate verdict and not a node status
not a mathematics claim about which direction is true (that independent direction proof already exists: artifacts/worker-004/f1_strictness_direction/report.json)
not a demand that F0 be rewritten; the disposition belongs to the controller / ESC-2
not a review of the rev14 window or of artifacts whose hashes move after this measurement
